title: "Basketball Score Heatmap"

  html:
    theme: journal

    toc: false
---

Explore the distribution of home and away score combinations across the season. Hover over the tiles to inspect each score pair and see how many games produced that exact result.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

games <- read_csv("Games.csv")

all_scores <- expand_grid(
  homeScore = seq(min(games$homeScore), max(games$homeScore), by = 1),
  awayScore = seq(min(games$awayScore), max(games$awayScore), by = 1)
)

density_data <- all_scores %>%
  left_join(
    games %>%
      group_by(homeScore, awayScore) %>%
      summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("homeScore", "awayScore")
  ) %>%
  mutate(count = replace_na(count, 0))

plot_ly(
  data = density_data,
  x = ~homeScore,
  y = ~awayScore,
  z = ~count,
  type = "heatmap",
  colorscale = list(
    list(0, "#ffffff"),
    list(1e-6, "#0b1345"),
    list(0.25, "#2c1f66"),
    list(0.5, "#6b3f90"),
    list(0.75, "#dc6f2f"),
    list(1, "#fee58c")
  ),
  hovertemplate = "Home: %{x}<br>Away: %{y}<br>Games: %{z}<extra></extra>",
  colorbar = list(title = "Frequency", thickness = 20, len = 0.65)
) %>%
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Interactive Scorigami: Home vs Away Score Frequency", x = 0.5),
    xaxis = list(title = "Home Score"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Away Score"),
    margin = list(l = 70, r = 40, t = 80, b = 70)
  )
```
